name: cockpit
description: Cockpit: a status card, a crew panel and a Flight Log for the agents you run beside Claude Code (tmux sessions, Codex, OpenCode, local models), a Black Box of this session's events, and the Deck. It only shows what your agents write to a few plain files (docs/PROTOCOL.md); with none of them it shows an empty-state card. It reads tmux and those files; it writes only when asked: /cockpit autopilot on|off|bug|idea, /handoff, and start|restart|clear after a y to confirm. /crew and /lanes are aliases of /cockpit

root.title: Project root
root.description: The project the agent files belong to. Leave empty to use the folder the session runs in. Everything else (folders, lanes, markers) is set in .cockpit/config.json: see the README

layout.title: Deck layout
layout.description: auto: a summary of at most 8 rows when the Deck sits inline above the prompt, two columns from 110 columns when docked, one column otherwise. /cockpit layout ... overrides it

motion.title: Deck motion
motion.description: Animate the connectors while a turn, an agent or a lane is working, or keep them still

panels.title: Deck panels
panels.description: Comma-separated panels in display order: vitals, gate, agents, receipt, log. Leave one out to hide it. A panel with nothing to show takes no room

maxCards.title: Agent cards before swimlanes
maxCards.description: Agent cards drawn side by side; more agents than this switch to swimlanes (1-6)

deckOnStart.title: Open the Deck on start
deckOnStart.description: Open the Deck pane when a session starts (otherwise /cockpit deck opens it)

statusLine.title: Status line
statusLine.description: Show unsaved work in the status line under the input box: "all saved", or "unsaved: N uncommitted files, M unpushed commits" summed over the git repositories named by "repos" in the config (default: the project root). Read every 30 seconds, never blocking
